Reused across the FY2024 (physical p25), FY2025 (p23) and H1 2026 (p31) disclosures. NOT the combined 混合键合设备 revenue basket (FY2025 CNY 1.36bn hundred-million line), the FY2023 混合键合设备 production/sales basket (which also covers die-to-wafer surface preparation), the 先进键合设备及配套量检测设备 basket, or the 半导体专用设备 production/sales perimeter.
